scripts.build: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix services/gateway && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/recruitment-service && npm install --prefix services/analysis-service && npm install --prefix services/worker-service
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "AUTH,RECRUIT,ANALYSIS,WORKER,GATEWAY" -c "blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green" "npm --prefix services/auth-service start" "npm --prefix services/recruitment-service start" "npm --prefix services/analysis-service start" "npm --prefix services/worker-service start" "npm --prefix services/gateway start"
